changelog.title: ORM Case-Sensitivity & Type-Hint Fixes
changes: 🐛 Fixed ORM class case-sensitivity issue (ORM → Orm) preventing database initialization on Linux
🐛 Fixed 4 broken RiseupORM type hints in DatabaseQuerySearchTrait causing fatal errors on filter operations
🐛 Fixed asset path depth (dirname level 3 → 4) so admin CSS/JS loads correctly

🔧 Fixed duplicate PathHelper import in qupload.php
🔧 Fixed PaginationConfigType method call in static property default (Admin.php)
🔧 Fixed duplicate <?php tag in admin-settings.php

changelog.title: PHP Syntax Fixes & Go Spacing Audit
changes: 🔧 Fixed duplicate <?php tag in admin-settings.php causing deployment syntax error
🛡️ Verified ManagerRestoreTrait.php syntax correctness for PHP 8.2 compatibility
📏 Full Go source audit: enforced blank-line-before-return and blank-line-before-if spacing rules
🧹 Fixed spacing violations across 10+ Go files in database, services, envelope, and logger packages

changelog.title: Major Version 2.0 — Full Codebase Audit & Hardening
changes: 🎯 Major version bump across all components: App, WP Plugin, QUpload, and PowerShell script
🛡️ Full PHP reliability audit: guarded all filesystem operations (scandir, copy, fopen, extractTo)
🔒 Eliminated silent catch blocks and ensured Throwable-first logging with stack traces
📏 Enforced 500-line PHP file limit across all plugins with trait decomposition
🧹 Removed double exception logging in error response pipelines
📦 QUpload plugin hardened: ZIP extraction, directory operations, and activation flows
🔧 Riseup Asia Uploader hardened: snapshot imports, sync push, admin log reading
📋 Centralized plugin identity via PluginConfigType enums (no literal log prefixes)
✅ All PHP enums standardized with PascalCase values and typed backing
